posts.body_html: Nice rich colour right from the start. And a nice bold splotch too. Will look terrific when fully formed. Will be interested to see if the infusion/bleeding of red on the hood continues. Does it usually in this particular clone Mike?
posts.body_text: Nice rich colour right from the start. And a nice bold splotch too. Will look terrific when fully formed. Will be interested to see if the infusion/bleeding of red on the hood continues. Does it usually in this particular clone Mike?

posts.body_html:
Yes, this clone typically has a very well defined red blotch in the "neck" and the red color sometimes creeps up into the lid a little bit. I've found that pretty much all of the lids from my rubricorporas will have more red in them as the pitcher ages.

FYI: This one was transplanted this year, and the trap, when developing, wasn't solid red until about a week after it opened. The red coloration in the throat will become more intense as the trap ages.
